info.title: CAO dashboard server
info.description: The Go dashboard server HTTP contract. Local mode uses a loopback bearer capability; hosted mode uses an authorized GitHub OAuth session and X-CSRF-Token on mutations. MCP and dashboard static assets are outside this contract.

load.description: Half-life 60 seconds: each event contributes one unit, decaying by half every minute. Keys are webhook, collection, and failure.

revision.description: Details are present only for an authorized caller.

present.description: Names of present known fields; distinguishes missing from explicit null.

extension.description: Open fields only; SQL JSON preserves exceptional numeric lexemes that JSONB cannot store.

id.description: Canonical identity; indexed with the namespace and source.

runId.description: Owning run relationship; indexed with the namespace and source.

sessionId.description: Owning session relationship; indexed with the namespace and source.

organizationHref.description: Scalar href columns reconstruct the known `{href}` link object on read.

createdAtRaw.description: PostgreSQL timestamps have microsecond resolution; text preserves exceptional original lexemes.

number.description: Column issue_number; distinct from canonical numeric key number.

attemptRaw.description: Numeric lexemes may exceed PostgreSQL NUMERIC's range or differ in formatting.

githubId.description: Provider IDs accept both JSON numbers and strings; kind preserves the input type.

Postgres.CanonicalRow.description: Known canonical columns are never copied into the extension object.

isCanonical.description: Only explicitly registered canonical sources use the native row table.

storageFallbackReason.description: Field/type diagnostic for a canonical source retaining legacy storage.

Postgres.Source.description: Source registry and resource accounting, scoped to a tenant.

QueryDefinition.description: A Dashboard Language query definition. See dashboard/site/dashboard.json for the language vocabulary.

QueryRequest.description: Requests may supply query definitions or use server-configured definitions.

RevisionEvent.description: JSON object within each SSE data frame (not the wire framing itself).
